name: nyx-v2-monorepo
description: nyx v2 monorepo — single Electron desktop shell (apps/desktop) supervising a single Rust sidecar (crates/nyx-sidecar) that wraps nyx-core. Tauri removed (PDR-0006).

scripts.test: bun run --filter nyx-v2-renderer test && bun run test:core && bun run test:contract
scripts.test:core: cargo test --workspace --lib && cargo test -p nyx-sidecar --test contract
scripts.test:contract: cargo test -p nyx-sidecar --test contract && cd contract && bun test
scripts.check: bun run --filter nyx-v2-renderer check && bun run check:core
